开花植物：从种子到下一代: Flowering plants: from seed to next generation
比较萌发、授粉受精与传播，发现一粒种子成为下一代需要哪些条件。: Compare germination, pollination, fertilization and dispersal to discover what a new plant generation needs.
植物生命的条件图: A condition map for plant life
给豆子一点水、一点空气和合适的温度，再翻开成长相册。: Give a bean water, air and a suitable temperature, then turn through its growth album.
太干了，豆子还没有吸到足够的水。试试湿润的环境。: Too dry: the bean has not taken up enough water. Try a damp setting.
豆子需要氧气。水太多会挤走土里的空气，正常成长会受阻。: A bean needs oxygen. Too much water displaces air in soil and prevents normal growth.
即使土壤湿润，氧气不足也会阻碍豆子起步。试试让空气进入。: Even in damp soil, too little oxygen limits the bean's start. Try allowing air in.
太冷了，豆子的成长会变慢。这里用暂停来表示，试试温暖。: Cold slows growth. We show this as a pause. Try warmth.
先猜猜：会先长根，还是先长叶？: Guess first: will a root or a leaf appear first?
种皮裂开，小根先钻出来，开始吸收水。: The seed coat splits. A tiny root emerges first and starts taking up water.
小根向下，嫩芽向上。豆子储存的养分帮助它起步。: The root grows down and the shoot grows up. Stored nutrients help the bean get started.
真叶展开了！长大的小苗还需要光，才能自己制造养分。: True leaves unfold! The growing seedling also needs light to make its own food.
种子吸水后恢复代谢；呼吸需要氧气，温度影响反应速度。以菜豆为例，胚根先突破种皮，: Water uptake restarts metabolism; respiration needs oxygen, and temperature affects reaction rates. In common beans the radicle emerges first, the hypocotyl lifts the cotyledons, and true leaves unfold. Stored reserves support early growth; established seedlings need photosynthesis.
相册不是按真实天数计时。这里只演示健康菜豆的典型过程；太冷用暂停表示，不代表所有: This album does not show elapsed days. It represents a typical healthy common bean. Cold is shown as a pause, though growth need not stop completely. Flooding represents limited oxygen supply. Species, dormancy, disease and light requirements vary.
水不是越多越好: More water is not always better
湿润的土里既有水，也有空气。豆子发芽需要水和氧气。: Damp soil contains both water and air. A germinating bean needs water and oxygen.
请大人陪你把豆子放在湿润的纸巾上，每天观察、画一张图。别把豆子一直泡在水里。: With a grown-up, place a bean on a damp paper towel. Observe and draw it each day. Do not keep it submerged.
土太干，已经长出的幼苗会受到缺水影响；它不会变回种子。这里暂停后续生长，试试恢复: Dry soil limits the existing seedling’s water supply; it does not turn back into a seed. Further growth is paused here. Try restoring moist conditions.
根和其他活细胞仍需要氧气。积水或缺少空气会妨碍后续生长；已经长出的结构不会倒回种: Roots and other living cells still need oxygen. Flooding or a lack of air limits further growth; existing structures do not reverse into a seed.
低温让这株幼苗的后续生长变慢。画面保留已长出的结构，用暂停表示影响。: Low temperature slows this seedling’s further growth. Its existing structures remain visible; pausing represents the effect.
孔隙有空气，种子却缺水: Air remains in the pores, but the seed lacks water
孔隙被水占据，氧气难进入: Water fills the pores, limiting oxygen access
有水膜，氧气仍不足: Water films are present, but oxygen is still limited
水膜和空气孔隙同时存在: Water films and air-filled pores coexist
干土缺少吸胀所需的水；本图不计算含水率。已经出现的根与叶只暂停后续生长，不会退回: Dry soil lacks water for imbibition; this scene does not calculate moisture content. Roots and leaves already present only pause further growth—they do not turn back into a seed.
种子吸水仍需氧气维持细胞呼吸。积水可减少土壤气相孔隙，使氧供应受限；本图把缺氧简: A hydrated seed still needs oxygen for cellular respiration. Waterlogging can reduce air-filled soil pores and limit oxygen supply. The model simplifies this to a pause; it predicts neither rot nor survival.
即使土壤湿润，如果周围氧气供应不足，种子的呼吸和后续生长仍会受限。本图不计算氧浓: Even in moist soil, insufficient surrounding oxygen limits the seed’s respiration and further growth. This model does not calculate oxygen concentration; it simplifies the limitation to a pause.
温度影响代谢反应速度；这里用暂停表示偏冷，不表示所有种子在低温下完全停止，也不是: Temperature affects metabolic reaction rates. A pause represents a cool condition here; it does not mean every seed stops completely in the cold, nor does it show real germination days.
水进入种子后，代谢重新活跃；子叶中的储备支持胚最初的生长。孔隙图只示意水与空气共: After water enters the seed, metabolism resumes; reserves in the cotyledons support the embryo’s first growth. The pore view only illustrates water and air together.
胚根先突破种皮，随后伸入土壤吸水；这段相册不按真实天数计时。: The radicle breaks through the seed coat first, then extends into soil to take up water. This album does not run on real days.
胚轴逐渐伸长，把子叶抬起；画面保留同一株菜豆的根与芽。: The hypocotyl lengthens and lifts the cotyledons. The picture keeps the root and shoot of the same bean plant.
真叶展开后，幼苗可进行光合作用，但达到开花成熟还需要继续生长与适宜环境。: Once true leaves unfold, the seedling can photosynthesize, but reaching flowering maturity still takes further growth and suitable conditions.
